text.en: Dog owners consistently describe Mellow Vibes as a welcoming, family-run environment where every dog is treated with genuine affection and patience. Clients note that anxious, fearful, or stubborn dogs are made to feel completely safe and relaxed, allowing them to socialize comfortably alongside the trainers' own pets.

title.en: Transformative results in obedience and calm

text.en: Reviewers report remarkable improvements following board and train programs, with reactive, anxious, or hyperactive dogs transforming into calm and well-mannered companions. Pet parents appreciate that their dogs learn reliable leash walking, sit commands, and settle quietly at home even around visitors and street distractions.

title.en: Patient coaching and lasting owner support

text.en: Clients commend trainers Paul and Boysie for their extensive knowledge, patience, and tailored approach to training both dogs and their handlers. Reviewers value the clear, easy-to-follow techniques taught during one-on-one sessions, highlighting the ongoing advice and supportive check-ins provided well after training concludes.

q.en: What training programs does Mellow Vibes Dog Training offer?

a.en: Programs include intensive board and train stays, private one-on-one coaching, puppy foundation manners, and reactivity rehabilitation.

q.en: Do trainers provide ongoing support after training sessions conclude?

a.en: Yes, clients note that Paul continues checking in after sessions to monitor progress, answer questions, and offer additional guidance.

q.en: How does the facility handle dogs that show leash reactivity or anxiety?

a.en: Reviewers report that trainers tailor structured exercises to each dog's personality, successfully reducing reactivity toward unfamiliar dogs and people.

q.en: Are training methods based on positive reinforcement?

a.en: Yes, all training emphasizes positive reinforcement techniques, compassionate handling, and clear boundary setting to build trust.
